definition: At the observation time, the just-completed five-minute close is strictly outside the prior complete NY BBOX. This is an observed outside state, not necessarily the first breach. Both means also beyond the same-side earlier-date Mean SessionPath boundary. First return is a later completed close inside the entire BBOX, inclusive of boundaries. Times are New York local close times. Added independent SessionPath side: +1 above upper extreme, -1 below lower extreme, 0 inside inclusive boundaries. Opposite-side states were previously included in legacy BBOX-only.
